finalText:
I rebooked Greta, Paul and Nina Weiss (booking WN4R8C) together onto ZX 470 → ZX 472, which arrives in New York (JFK) at 18:40 on 9 November. The app confirmed "Rebooked 3 passengers to ZX 470 → ZX 472".

Each passenger kept their cabin: Greta in Business, Paul and Nina in Economy. Both legs had seats left in both cabins after the move (ZX 470 went to 3 economy / 1 business and ZX 472 to 2 economy / 1 business).

The only connection arriving earlier, ZX 450 → ZX 460 (17:55), was ruled out because ZX 460 has no free business seat for Greta.
